description: Quote the exact Gold price to clean up one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Retopology: fewer, tidier faces, with an optional face target, quads, and UVs in the same pass (uv_in_same_pass). Price by version: v3.0 50 Gold (default), 55 Gold with quads, v2.0 45 Gold, v1.0 15 Gold. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_edit_3d_cleanup with the same inputs and quote_token.

face_limit.description: Target number of faces, from 100 to 200000.

keep_textures.description: Keep the textures on the result (default true). Free.

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

quads.description: Quad faces instead of triangles (default false). Costs 5 Gold more on v3.0.

uv_in_same_pass.description: Also unwrap UVs in the same pass (version v3.0 only). Free.

name: chargen_quote_3d_cleanup
title: Quote 3D clean up
